history.provenance: The manuscript was brought from Eduard Rüppell's trip to Ethiopia in the 1830s. It had been lost with six other Rüppell manuscripts in July 1945 during a manuscript transport and was considered lost for more than 65 years before it was rediscovered with another manuscript and returned to the library of the university of Frankfurt.

msItem.title: Tārika Walda ʾAmid (β-recension)
msItem.note: Most sections from Peleg (17th generation) to the end have been abridged and paraphrased similar to Frankfurt, Universitätsbibliothek Johann Christian Senckenberg, Frankfurt Ms. or. 40. The text includes a list of the patriarchs of Alexandria, ending with Gabrǝʾel, the 97th patriarch, who held office during the reign of Śarḍa Dǝngǝl, pointing to the same Vorlage as ʾAddis ʾAbabā, Manbara Lǝʿul Qǝddus Mārqos, EMML 21.
